coverage.notes: This case verifies the non-mock gallery upload flow against the existing local-dev frontend/backend pair, including upload ticket issuance, direct backend upload, and post-upload gallery refresh.

preconditions: The seeded standard user can sign in on the local-dev frontend.
The local frontend and backend development servers are already running.
The backend upload blocker fix has been applied and gallery upload tickets can be issued for the standard user.
The local-dev frontend is running with MOCK_MODE=false from .env.e2e.
assertions: The standard user can open the gallery upload dialog.
The direct upload request to the backend succeeds.
The uploaded asset appears in the gallery and usage/list refresh requests succeed.
The uploaded asset can be removed again to keep the case repeatable.
notes: Use this case after gallery runtime smoke passes on the existing local-dev server lane. The upload uses a real image file and sends the binary to the backend directly instead of mock mode.
